newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe Pacific Gold mill processing ore.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe Pacific Gold mill processing ore.

text.p: Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp said Thursday its new Sage Mill at the Twim Creeks Mine started processing oxide ore and was expected to process about 160,000 to 190,000 tons of the ore in the fourth quarter.
The mill was also expected to produce about 10,000 to 15,000 ounces of gold in the fourth quarter, it said.
The oxide ore would have an average grade of 0.08 ounce per ton, the company said.
Santa Fe Pacific said it expected its Twin Creeks Mine would produce 445,000 to 455,000 ounces of gold at cash cost of $190 to $200 per ounce in 1996.
The oxide ore processing was another step in preparation for the commissioning of the Phase I autoclave circuit at the Sage Mill on schedule for the first quarter 1997, it said.
